criteria.requirement: Implement dotenv.environment.temporary_environment(values, *, override=False, remove_none=False) as a context manager. Validate the whole string/None mapping and environment key restrictions before any write. Apply only eligible keys, yield the tuple of changed keys, and restore exactly their pre-entry values or absence on normal/exceptional exit. Preserve unrelated changes inside the block and support nested contexts. None is ignored unless remove_none is explicit; existing keys require override. Do not claim thread isolation or mutate mapping inputs or permanent load_dotenv behavior.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
